steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies. The platinum pops on its own the moment the last one lands — no separate task.
No online or DLC trophies exist, so everything is earned in single player.
Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is automatic and cannot be missed.
Finish Chapter 1. Automatic story trophy — it pops when the chapter ends.
Finish Chapter 2. Automatic story trophy — it pops when the chapter ends.
Finish Chapter 3. Automatic story trophy — it pops when the chapter ends.
Finish Chapter 4. Automatic story trophy — it pops when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.t: Finish the final mission. Automatic story trophy — it pops when the mission ends.

Sources disagree on where the finale sits: PowerPyx places it after the five chapters, while eGamers quotes guides that put it in Chapter 5. Both versions are shown here; either way, finishing the story pops it.
Finish the mission Breakfast Run. Automatic — it pops when the mission ends.
Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. Automatic — it pops when the mission ends.
Finish the mission Child's Play. Automatic — it pops when the mission ends.
Finish the mission Headliners. Automatic — it pops when the mission ends.
Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. Automatic — it pops when the mission ends.
Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. Automatic — it pops when the mission ends.
Finish the story first. The 100% Completion Checklist unlocks after the credits, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work the checklist. It is about 60% true completion, not everything: you need 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals and 50 of 66 weapons.
Complete 70 of the 80 challenges — you can skip the 10 hardest. The only tasks that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
Both guides rank this the hardest trophy and the longest grind, around 100 hours of the roughly 200-hour platinum.
Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are marked on the map — do them as you travel between missions.
For the 100% checklist you need 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.

steps.t: Try all 9 activity types once: stunts, shooting range, drone races, races, fishing, arcade, bowling, and the rest the game lists.
You will touch most of them naturally while chasing the other activity trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

steps.t: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Ranges are found across Leonida — each has its own par score to beat.
Shooting ranges are one of the few tasks the 100% checklist needs in full, so golding them all serves two trophies at once.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

steps.t: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own race — win one at each.
Drone races are needed in full for the 100% checklist, so this trophy is on the road to A Long Road.
Win 20 different races. Any race type counts — road, off-road, boat or air — as long as each is a different event.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

steps.t: Find Cal and beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are one of the 9 activity types.
Finish one arcade game, start to end, at any arcade in Leonida.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.

steps.t: Follow Andy's questline to its final mission and finish it. Stranger questlines open as the story progresses.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

steps.t: Follow Kenton's questline to its final mission and finish it.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.

steps.t: Follow Billy's questline to its final mission and finish it.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

steps.t: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strands open as the story progresses and stay open in free roam.
Watch out: Yago's race in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive (hourglass icon). Save first and race it the moment it appears, or the strand can fail.
Sources disagree on the count: PowerPyx counts 4 counting strands while other guides count all 8. Both versions are shown here — finish all 8 and you are covered either way.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.

steps.t: Follow Randy's questline to its final mission and finish it.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

steps.t: Follow Tyrone's questline to its final mission and finish it.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

steps.t: Meditate at all 18 spots in 10 locations across Leonida, with both Jason and Lucia.
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house BEFORE Chapter 1 ends — it is offered in Chapter 1 and gone after it. This is the one possibly missable trophy in the game.
The last meditation cannot be done until both leads play together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

Sources disagree on the count: guides say 18 meditations for the trophy while the 100% list says 15, and whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is required is still unconfirmed. Do all 18 and keep a Chapter 1 manual save.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

steps.t: Follow Bret's questline. The unique animal Bret wants is still unconfirmed — no launch-day guide gives a method yet.
Keep playing Bret's quests and check back: the method will be pinned down as more players reach it. Do not rely on an unverified method.
Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found across Leonida — there are 18 sets in total.
For the 100% checklist, 15 full sets count, so keep collecting past 3 if you are chasing A Long Road.
WAiNK It at 100 different locations across Leonida. Each spot counts once — spread out and cover the map.
Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. They come in 8 groups of 10 and are tracked in the game's progress menu from the start.
For 100% you need 70, and you can skip the 10 hardest — so pick the 50 easiest for this trophy and keep the rest for A Long Road.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

steps.t: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the heat and escape. Use alleys and off-road routes to break line of sight.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

steps.t: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level between them. Keep moving — do not stop to fight.
Discover 100 vehicles. Scan them as you drive — looking at a vehicle through the binoculars (or the in-game scan) registers it.
For 100% you need 200 of 277 vehicles, so keep scanning past 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps.t: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Pick a fight with a group, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

steps.t: Leave VCIA (the airport) in an unscheduled way — take a plane or a fast vehicle out without following the normal departure.
Deal with Rhino tanks — get into a fight where Rhinos show up and handle them. It pops from the tank encounter.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

steps.t: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and guards, and get out before the alarm.
Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape the 4-star heat. A fast bike is the best getaway — the heat fades once you break line of sight.
Sources disagree on the count: PowerPyx lists 8 large bank vaults while KeenGamer's 100% table counts 22 bank jobs. Different categories, both shown — robbing 5 covers this trophy either way.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

steps.t: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush one on the road, crack it open, and lose the heat.
Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you visit each one — check the map for the gaps and drive through them.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

steps.t: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang has its own operations — hit one per gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

steps.t: No launch-day guide gives a method yet — unconfirmed. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but the exact trigger is not pinned down.
Check back as guides update. Do not rely on an unverified method.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

steps.t: No launch-day guide gives a method yet — unconfirmed. The description points to smashing out of a vehicle showroom, but which showroom and how are not pinned down.
Check back as guides update. Do not rely on an unverified method.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

steps.t: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. A full game (follow-through) is what counts.
A partnership moment with mass appeal — it pops from partnership content played with your partner.
The exact trigger is not yet documented in the launch guides, so treat it as story-adjacent cleanup in free roam.
Make choices — the game tracks a count to 500. Keep choosing through dialogue and actions and the count climbs.
No launch-day guide gives a method yet — unconfirmed. The description hints at succeeding on a second try, but the exact trigger is not pinned down.
Check back as guides update. Do not rely on an unverified method.
No launch-day guide gives a method yet — unconfirmed. The description points to witnessing something strange, but what and where are not pinned down.
Check back as guides update. Do not rely on an unverified method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

steps.t: No launch-day guide gives a method yet — unconfirmed. The description points to knocking someone down with a melee drive-by, but the exact setup is not pinned down.
Check back as guides update. Do not rely on an unverified method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

steps.t: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies — launder them in chunks through contacts.
Spend $100,000 across all shops. It counts cumulatively — weapons, clothes, food and cars all add up.
Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. They are bought through the in-game property listings.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

steps.t: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Any 10 vehicles you own count — register them in the app.
